name: SN 2020sgf field (Hubble)
blurb: The field of SN 2020sgf, a Type Ic supernova, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2020sgf-hubble
story: A star stripped of its outer layers exploded here as SN 2020sgf, a Type Ic supernova whose fading light may have pulsed with a steady rhythm. Hubble came back long after the blast to study the faded supernova and its surroundings.

claims.text: SN 2020sgf is a Type Ic supernova
SN 2020sgf is a candidate for periodic light-curve modulations
Type Ib/c supernovae are stripped-envelope supernovae
Hubble program 16691 takes late-time snapshots of recent transients and their environments
